Kuvitus: talvi-ilta ja leikkauskuva omak: Illustration: a winter evening and a cutaway view of a detached house. On the left, an electric stove glows in the sauna; in the middle, a kettle steams in the kitchen next to the refrigerator and a ceiling lamp is lit; on the right, the living room has a television and a floor lamp. An electricity meter is on the outer wall of the house, and there is snow outside.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: teho P kilowattei: Graph to scale: power P in kilowatts as a function of time t in hours. The power of the kettle is 2.0 kW for a time of 0–0.10 h, so its area is a narrow, tall rectangle. The power of the television is 0.10 kW for a time of 0–2.0 h, so its area is a wide, low rectangle. The area of each rectangle is 0.20 kWh: the same energy.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: vasemmalla: Schematic figure, not to scale: on the left an electric radiator with a power of 1 kW and orange heat arrows above it. In the middle a clock whose minute hand goes around once, that is 1 hour. On the right an electricity meter whose reading increases by 1 kilowatt-hour. Below the figure: 1 kWh = 1000 W · 3600 s = 3.6 MJ.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: pesukoneen teho P: Graph to scale: the power P of a washing machine in kilowatts as a function of time t in hours during one wash program. The grid spacing is 0.2 kW on the vertical axis and 0.25 h on the horizontal axis. The power is first 2.0 kW for a time of 0–0.25 h, then 0.2 kW for 0.25–1.25 h and finally 0.4 kW for 1.25–1.5 h, after which the machine switches off.
